title: SmartFurnace
description: Say goodbye to laggy hopper setups! Automate all furnaces within a massive 3x3 chunk area using just an Input and Output chest. Smart splitting, zero lag.
body:
# 🔥 SmartFurnace: The Ultimate Smelting Automation

Tired of building massive, lag-inducing hopper chains and redstone setups just to smelt your ores? **SmartFurnace** is a lightweight, Vanilla+ Quality of Life plugin that revolutionizes how you smelt items. 

Connect a single Input Chest and an Output Chest, and watch as the plugin intelligently distributes your ores and fuels to all furnaces in a massive 48x48 block (3x3 Chunk) area!

## ✨ Key Features

* 🚀 **Smart Split Algorithm:** Throw 64 iron ores and some coal into the input chest. The plugin will calculate the math and distribute the items **equally** among all available furnaces in the network.
* ⚡ **Zero Lag Performance:** Unlike other plugins that scan every single block (causing TPS drops), SmartFurnace uses native `TileEntity` chunk scanning. It only reads active furnaces, making it incredibly server-friendly.
* 🌍 **Massive Range:** The network covers a 3x3 chunk area (the chunk your input chest is in, plus the 8 surrounding chunks). Put your chests in the base and your furnaces in the basement!
* 🛡️ **Exploit-Free Setup:** Uses an "Itemless Setup Mode" via commands. No physical setup wands are given to players, completely eliminating free-item exploits.
* 📦 **Auto-Collection:** Smelted items are instantly vacuumed into the Output Chest. 

## 🛠️ How to Use

Setting up your industrial furnace network takes only 5 seconds:

1. Type the command `/smartfurnace` (or `/sf`) to enter Setup Mode.
2. With an **empty hand**, **LEFT CLICK** the chest you want to use as your Input (Put ores and fuel here).
3. **RIGHT CLICK** the chest you want to use as your Output (Cooked items will appear here).
4. *Boom!* The network is established. The setup mode will automatically close.

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

* `/smartfurnace` (Aliases: `/sf`): Toggles the setup mode.
* *Note: Setup mode resets automatically after a successful connection to prevent accidental clicks.*

## ⚙️ Technical Details
* **Version:** Paper 1.21+ (Also works on forks like Purpur).
* **Fuel Support:** Automatically detects Vanilla fuels (Coal, Charcoal, Coal Blocks, Dried Kelp Blocks, Blaze Rods, Lava Buckets) and routes them to the fuel slots.

---
*Built for survival servers, SMPs, and players who love efficiency without the lag.*
